About this item

  • Eye-Caring Desk Lamp: With 56 top SMD2835 LED beads for emitting a 3000K-5500K soft, stable and non-flickering light, which is friendly to your eyes, ideal for reading, work, or rest. Adopting the most advanced LED technology, can save up to 90% energy compared to traditional ones. 10-watt LED lights provide a maximum of 900 lumens.
  • Intelligent Induction Auto Dimming Mode and Memory Function: The desk lamp can sense ambient light and automatically adjust the appropriate brightness. Automatically brighten the dim lighting environment to avoid fatigue caused by dim lighting. The bright light environment is automatically dimmed to avoid discomfort caused by too strong light. The lamp’s memory function retains preset settings and reboots accordingly.
  • 3 Color Modes and Rotary Knob Dimming: Table lamp is controlled by knob switch and key switch. 1. Power on and off: press the rotary knob button, 2. Change color mode: Press the button on the right to adjust the color: Natural light - White light - Warm light. 3. Adjust the brightness: Turn the rotary knob to adjust the brightness. You can adjust the brightness of any color modes.
  • Gentle Light and Convenient USB Charging Port: Shines a non flickering light that brightens your space without harming your eyes; ideal for reading, working or studying. Designed with 1 USB charging port on the lamp base, convenient to charge your mobile phones, tablets, kindles or other electric devices. The USB port can be used whether the lamp is on or off.
  • Sturdy Metal Material and Anti-slip Design: Featured with heavy-duty rugged metal lamp shade and base, sturdy and aesthetic. Super sturdy metal construction ensures its reliability. Anti-slip pad is firmly attached to the surface of the bottom. Sturdy flexible neck allows you to adjust your desk lamp with ease and to direct the light wherever you want. 5V, 2A ADAPTER INCLUDED

      The BOHON LED Desk Lamp is the perfect addition to my workspace and bedside setup. This lamp is packed with features that make it an ideal choice for reading, working, or relaxing.

      💡 3 Color Modes & Dimmable Brightness

      I love that this lamp offers three color modes (warm, cool, and neutral light), which can be dimmed to my preferred level of brightness. Whether I’m reading at night or working during the day, there’s a setting to suit every situation.

      🔌 USB Charging Port

      The built-in USB charging port is incredibly convenient. I can easily charge my phone or other devices without needing an extra outlet. It’s a great feature, especially for bedside use.

      🌟 Intelligent Induction Auto-Dimming

      The auto-dimming function is a standout feature. The lamp adjusts the brightness based on the ambient light in the room, creating a comfortable environment without me having to fiddle with the settings.

      🌀 Flexible Gooseneck Design

      The flexible gooseneck allows me to adjust the angle and position of the light effortlessly. It’s sturdy yet easy to maneuver, making it perfect for focused task lighting.

      ⚡ Included AC Adapter

      The inclusion of an AC adapter is a thoughtful touch, saving me the hassle of purchasing one separately. The lamp is easy to set up and works right out of the box.

      🎉 Final Thoughts

      The BOHON LED Desk Lamp is a versatile, well-designed product that delivers on both functionality and style. It’s ideal for anyone needing a reliable, adjustable, and feature-rich lamp for their workspace, bedside, or office. Highly recommend!

      As a treat to myself I did a work desk refresh and did a purple desk haul. Getting all the same shade of purple is a challenge, but I am picky about what I want out of a desk lamp. I can't lie I was prepared to be disappointed but I found myself pleasantly surprised with this little lamp. I found the size of the lamp to be just perfect. I love that I can change the lamp from a warm light to a cold light. (I prefer warm light most days) You can make the light as bright or as dim as you want, I just have it turned all the way up. Its got a sturdy base and is powered by USB-C so you can give it a longer cord if needed.

      4 out of 5 stars
      A decent desk lamp
      Reviewed in the United States on February 22, 2023
      Color: Matt Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I like that this desk lamp has a small footprint and can be placed off to the side, out of the way, but then using the gooseneck the light can be brought in where it is needed. I also like that it is quite bright and can be dimmed from low light to full output. The light color itself can be adjusted between 3 levels, warm, cool or a mix of warm and cool. I personally prefer the white cool light as it seems like a better color for a work light. I don’t use the ambient sensor function so can’t comment. The base is heavy and holds the lamp without tipping even when the gooseneck is cantilevered far out. There is a light diffuser on the end of the lamp shade which can be removed if you want the full blast harsh light, which may be more useful in some situations. There is a usb charger port. The dimming control is a little funky and the click stops were not expected. I would rather have a smooth silent dimmer than one with detents. Also the range of lowest light to highest light is not very wide. Nevertheless, at this price point there isn’t much to complain about. This is a nice bright lamp with more functionality than one would expect at such a low price and seems well made. It is recommended.

    About this Item

    • Eye-Caring Desk Lamp: With 56 top SMD2835 LED beads for emitting a 3000K-5500K soft, stable and non-flickering light, which is friendly to your eyes, ideal for reading, work, or rest. Adopting the most advanced LED technology, can save up to 90% energy compared to traditional ones. 10-watt LED lights provide a maximum of 900 lumens.
    • Intelligent Induction Auto Dimming Mode and Memory Function: The desk lamp can sense ambient light and automatically adjust the appropriate brightness. Automatically brighten the dim lighting environment to avoid fatigue caused by dim lighting. The bright light environment is automatically dimmed to avoid discomfort caused by too strong light. The lamp’s memory function retains preset settings and reboots accordingly.
    • 3 Color Modes and Rotary Knob Dimming: Table lamp is controlled by knob switch and key switch. 1. Power on and off: press the rotary knob button, 2. Change color mode: Press the button on the right to adjust the color: Natural light - White light - Warm light. 3. Adjust the brightness: Turn the rotary knob to adjust the brightness. You can adjust the brightness of any color modes.
    • Gentle Light and Convenient USB Charging Port: Shines a non flickering light that brightens your space without harming your eyes; ideal for reading, working or studying. Designed with 1 USB charging port on the lamp base, convenient to charge your mobile phones, tablets, kindles or other electric devices. The USB port can be used whether the lamp is on or off.
    • Sturdy Metal Material and Anti-slip Design: Featured with heavy-duty rugged metal lamp shade and base, sturdy and aesthetic. Super sturdy metal construction ensures its reliability. Anti-slip pad is firmly attached to the surface of the bottom. Sturdy flexible neck allows you to adjust your desk lamp with ease and to direct the light wherever you want. 5V, 2A ADAPTER INCLUDED

    Product Description

    Key Advantages: Intelligent Induction Auto Dimming Mode Sense ambient light and automatically adjust the appropriate brightness.Note: When in this mode, adjusting the brightness has no effect. 3 Color Modes & Stepless Dimming Every color has a great range of brightness, meet your demand easily. Integrated USB Port and Non Flickering Light Convenient for you to use in daily life Wide Application Ideal for home, office, college dorm, it will bring you a peaceful and warm night Smart Memory Function Keep the power connected, it can remember the brightness and lighting mode which you last set, you do not need to readjust it when you turn it on next time. Ideal Non Flickering Light A contemporary take on a lighting classic. Designed to emit a soft, stable, non-flickering wash of light that’s friendly on your eyes, helping you avoid eye fatigue caused by flickering light and harsh glare. Technical Specifications: Power Adapter: 5V / 2A INCLUDED CRI: 90+ LED Quantity: 56 LEDs Color temperature: 3000-5500K Lumens: 100-900 Lumen Wattage: Max 10W Power Cord Length : 31.5 inches (80cm) What You Get？ 1 x LED Desk lamp 1 x USB Cable 1 x AC Adapter 1 x User Manual
